cves: A vulnerability was identified in makeplane plane up to 1.4.2. Impacted is an unknown function of the component API Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument X-Forwarded-For leads to reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

Plane is an open-source project management tool. Prior to 1.4.0, the issue-relation endpoint accepts issue UUIDs in the request body without validating that they belong to the caller's workspace. An authenticated user can create relations linking their own issues to issues in any other workspace on the instance, leaking issue metadata through activity events. This issue is fixed in 1.4.0.

Plane is an open-source project management tool. Prior to 1.4.0, WorkspaceOwnerPermission does not require is_active=True when checking whether a user is a workspace owner. A deactivated user can therefore remain authorized as the workspace owner and retain owner-level access. This issue is fixed in 1.4.0.

An authenticated user can link issues from any workspace to modules in their own workspace. This issue is fixed in 1.4.0.

Plane is an open-source project management tool. A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability has been identified in Plane versions prior to 0.23. The vulnerability allows authenticated users to upload SVG files containing malicious JavaScript code as profile images, which gets executed in victims' browsers when viewing the profile image.
